text:
Jules Martin: Heads up 1 — API ref for POST /v1/generate uses `max_output_tokens` in the examples, but runtime expects `max_new_tokens`. This breaks the Node/Go snippets that forward the body unchanged.

Hiro Tanaka: yikes. paste the snippet?

Jules Martin: current example:```
{
  "model": "gpt-mini",
  "prompt": "short summary",
  "max_output_tokens": 150
}
```
Should be `max_new_tokens`. We changed the param name during the API cleanup last year but missed a few docs pages.

Priya Raman: Good catch. Impact: SDKs using examples will send `max_output_tokens` which runtime ignores (defaults applied). Customers see shorter outputs.

Hiro Tanaka: I'll open a tiny docs PR to update examples, Node/Go snippets, and add a migration note under params: "Older examples used `max_output_tokens`; the server expects `max_new_tokens` — convert value unchanged." Also add a quick docs CI grep to find other occurrences.

Jules Martin: Please also add a short compatibility note at top of the endpoint: "Param renamed: max_output_tokens -> max_new_tokens (no behavioral change)."

Priya Raman: LGTM. Add me for copy review. Also please run the updated curl example against staging in CI (`--silent --fail`) to ensure it still returns 2xx.

docs-bot: PR created by hiro-tanaka: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1602 title: "docs(generate): rename max_output_tokens -> max_new_tokens in examples and add migration note"

Hiro Tanaka: PR up. Replaced occurrences, added param note, CI grep finds 3 legacy examples which I updated. Ran curl smoke on staging, returns 200.

Priya Raman: Reviewed and merged. Small nit fixed in copy.

Jules Martin: Thanks! Filing ENG-1267 to add a linter that flags deprecated param names in docs generation so this doesn't slip again. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
